name: a mountain hotel and a resort
did: Helipad rebuilt: a hotel driven into the mountainside with a lobby, a bar and four rooms off an upstairs corridor; two pools; a tunnel through the mountain at head height with a stair down to the pad; terraces climbing to it; a jungle clearing to spawn in. Resort rebuilt: two hotel blocks with rooms, doors, balconies and stairwells, and two full pools. Every interior has real doors that swing.
onAccept: The armoury reloads. Your loadouts are kept; anything you had equipped that moved class is still where you left it.
